title: Investigate Unexpected Ingestion and License Usage
objectives: Investigate Unexpected Ingestion and License Usage
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: Compare the actual recorded-input byte counts for v7_noise with v7_operations in Monitoring Console and index=_internal source=*license_usage.log type=Usage st=v7_noise. Advance to the following minute if needed. These actual bytes are added to the generated license baseline.

Disable only the monitor for /var/log/practice/noise.log on idx01 using native inputs.conf disabled=1, activate it, and inspect the running configuration. Keep the operations input working and independently verify its three records. Run the license-usage query and open Job Inspector to retain your evidence.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
